entries.title: The turn is six phases driven by action dice
entries.summary: Run recovery/draw, Fellowship, Hunt allocation, action resolution, and victory check in order. The two sides alternate spending available action-die results during action resolution; a Fellowship-movement die is placed into the Hunt Box.

source_locator.document_section: The Game Turn / Summary of the Turn
source_locator.locator: The Game Turn / Summary of the Turn; p. 18

entries.title: Second Edition changes affect timing, not just components
entries.summary: For a First Edition comparison, verify the changed character abilities, revised event use, altered Dwarven setup, mandatory Shadow Hunt allocation after a prior Hunt, revised Hunt sequence, and Mordor entry rule. Do not silently mix editions.

source_locator.locator: Notes on the Second Edition; p. 3

entries.title: Ring outcomes end the game immediately
entries.summary: Two Ring-based outcomes bypass the later Victory Check: the Shadow wins when Ring-bearer corruption reaches 12; the Free Peoples win when the Ring reaches Crack of Doom with corruption below 12.

source_locator.document_section: Winning the Game / Ring-based Victory Conditions
source_locator.locator: Winning the Game / Ring-based Victory Conditions; p. 44

entries.title: Military victories are checked at turn end
entries.summary: After the action phase, check settlement control for military victory. Shadow wins with Free Peoples settlements worth at least 10 points; Free Peoples wins with Shadow settlements worth at least 4.

source_locator.document_section: Winning the Game / Military Victory Conditions
source_locator.locator: Winning the Game / Military Victory Conditions; pp. 44–46

entries.title: Cities and strongholds are the military score units
entries.summary: A captured enemy city contributes one military victory point and a captured enemy stronghold contributes two. Recapture removes the control marker and the associated conquest points.

source_locator.locator: Capturing a Settlement; Victory Points; pp. 32, 44

entries.title: Second Edition permits entry from either named gateway
entries.summary: In Second Edition, the Fellowship can enter Mordor from Minas Morgul or Morannon without first declaring the Fellowship; it may therefore enter while still hidden. Check the complete reference for the subsequent track and Hunt details.

source_locator.locator: Notes on the Second Edition; p. 3
